paper: Brazovskii (2003), arXiv:cond-mat/0306006v2, 'Theory of the ferroelectric phase in organic conductors: optics and physics of solitons' (ECRYS-2002 proceedings)
reimplementation: Independent, from analytic equations in the corpus .txt. NOT author code.
type: analytic/theory proceedings paper (no numerical tables; functional forms + order-of-magnitude claims)

claims_extracted_and_checked.combined_Mott_Hubbard_H: HU = -Us cos2phi - Ub sin2phi = -U cos(2phi-2alpha), U=sqrt(Us^2+Ub^2), tan2alpha=Ub/Us [l.96]
claims_extracted_and_checked.soliton_charges: pi-soliton holon q=1e; alpha-soliton (FE wall) q=-2alpha/pi or 1-2alpha/pi (noninteger) [l.114-119]
claims_extracted_and_checked.optical_edge: collective mode gap omega_t ~ pi*gamma*Delta < 2Delta (small gamma) [l.153]; photoconductivity gap = 2Delta [l.22]

headline_number.quantity: optical collective-mode edge relative to photoconductivity gap, omega_t/(2*Delta) = pi*gamma/2
headline_number.paper_statement: omega_t ~ pi*gamma*Delta < 2*Delta (edge lies well below 2Delta) [l.153, l.22]

verdict.coverage_rationale: All analytic relations in Sections I-II reimplemented and verified: combined-MH Hamiltonian & alpha, soliton charges/lengths, gap & optical-edge scaling, full eq.(2) dielectric function with resonance/soft-mode/antiresonance, Curie law, spin gap. Not covered: quantitative breather spectrum between wt and 2Delta, microscopic derivation of Ckin/Cpot mass renormalization, 3D-ordering energetics (paper gives no closed forms for these).
verdict.agreement_rationale: Every algebraic identity is exact to machine precision (H form 4e-16, Fano=1, Curie 1/|t| exact). Paper's '~/≈' resonance & soft-mode formulas confirmed as leading (1-Z)->0 limit of exact denominator roots (err 1.2e-5 at Z=0.9999, monotonically decreasing toward T0). Curie amplitude A~1e3 reproduced (900) matching paper's own estimate; the ~1e4 is the *experimental* number the paper only approximately matches. No exact numeric tables exist in this proceedings paper to fit against, so agreement is on functional forms and orders of magnitude.
honest_gaps: Paper is a short ECRYS-2002 proceedings: presents formulas 'without derivations' (l.173) and no numerical tables; agreement is necessarily against functional forms + order-of-magnitude claims, not tabulated data.

Overall normalization constants (C in Delta~U^..., wcr(T)/ωt(T) temperature laws, wp*) are not fixed by the paper; chosen representative values. Dimensionless ratios and scaling exponents are what is tested.
Quantum breather bound-state spectrum (between wt and 2Delta) and the sine-Gordon soliton mass/quantum corrections are mentioned but not given as closed formulas; not reimplemented.
Ckin/Cpot mass-enhancement (ripplon analogy) given only as scaling relations gamma=(1/4pi)(vrho/vF)^... ; identities checked structurally but not against data.
